title: Butterfly Little Black Princess Clipart
author: Jalina Art Studio
description:
JUST BROWSING? WHY NOT TAKE A LOOK AT MY ENTIRE SHOP – JALINA ART STUDIO!
Embrace the wonder of childhood and imagination with adorable chibi characters, including the Little Black Princess and Afro Girl. Let your creativity take flight with the graceful Butterfly Fairy, adding a touch of whimsy and elegance to your designs. Dive into a world of fantasy and adventure with this collection of fantasy clipart, perfect for illustrating storybooks, creating invitations, or decorating crafts.
Suitable for:
greeting cards, invitations, printable wall art, scrapbooking, prints, mugs, posters, stickers, website designs and social media – and much more!
This product comes in 1 Zipped folder (58.2 MB) and includes:
21 clipart elements
300 DPI
2000 x 2000 pixels, PNG
Transparent background
The watermark will be missing on the uploaded file
This product has been created by Jalina Art Studio.
Thank you for supporting my work!
